governance.title: High-Risk Mutations / Transactions / Management — CTO Remediation
governance.status: IMPLEMENTED / TESTED / VERIFIED — CTO ACCEPTANCE PENDING

remediationSummary.primaryBlocker: Insufficient authorization, identity binding, and replay/financial mutation protections on high-risk campaign routes

defectsRemediated.defect: Anonymous or cross-campaign callers could mutate booth status/lead/voter data
defectsRemediated.remediation: Enforced authentication, verified booth existence and campaign ownership; unauthorized and cross-campaign mutations rejected with 403

defectsRemediated.defect: Arbitrary callers could assign sensitive campaign coordinator roles or spoof isKshetraUser status
defectsRemediated.remediation: Enforced caller authentication and campaign authority; ordinary citizens rejected with 403; coordinator role assignment restricted to campaign owner/admin; isKshetraUser strictly verified against registered users

defectsRemediated.defect: Unauthenticated callers or cross-principal callers could inspect wallet balance
defectsRemediated.remediation: Enforced authentication; bound lookup to authenticated principal; cross-principal requests rejected with 403

defectsRemediated.defect: Unauthenticated callers or cross-principal callers could inspect financial transaction ledger
defectsRemediated.remediation: Enforced authentication; bound lookup to authenticated principal; cross-principal requests rejected with 403

defectsRemediated.defect: Order creation was not bound to authenticated principal
defectsRemediated.remediation: Enforced authentication; bound order creation to effective politician ID; registered pending orders in authoritative memory store

defectsRemediated.defect: Arbitrary client-supplied payment references and amounts were credited without proof of legitimate order, cross-wallet verification, or replay protection
defectsRemediated.remediation: Enforced authentication; verified order exists in pending store; verified order ownership matches caller; verified amount consistency; verified cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 signature when secret present; implemented strict replay/idempotency protection ensuring wallet is credited exactly once and replayed calls return idempotent acknowledgment without double-crediting

defectsRemediated.defect: Arbitrary caller could select any politicianId and trigger wallet deduction and telecom dispatch
defectsRemediated.remediation: Enforced authentication; verified campaign authority and identity binding BEFORE wallet lookup, BEFORE wallet deduction, and BEFORE telecom provider dispatch; unauthorized attempts halted with 403 with zero financial deduction and zero telecom dispatch
